incident_binding.claim: The three defects the failure run combined -- an unmapped Command Center env write, --remove-orphans reconciling before the configuration error surfaced, and release markers advanced ahead of activation -- are each now refused by a named assertion in scripts/ci/nextjs-deploy-wiring.test.ts, and each refusal was mutation-proven.

runtime_proof_pending.reason: CEP-E7 requires a populated runtime_proof block for the app-runtime profile, and the only sanctioned source is ci-db-proof-receipt/v2 from CI's `Writable DB proof (staging only)` job. That receipt binds exactly to the SHA its run was triggered by, which pre-merge is the merge-preview commit, not the PR head: harvestCiDbProofForMergeSha(ff4ff627c...) returns receipt_invalid with 'downloaded receipt sha=89f7d3644f085ab969efb5b4187cb7e154f4dc1e does not equal the merge SHA ... its run was triggered by'. The block is therefore unpopulatable before the merge exists, and is harvested by post-merge-lane-close.yml at closeout.
runtime_proof_pending.not_fabricated: No runtime_proof was hand-authored. Populating it from anything other than the verified receipt would be exactly the fabrication the harvest module exists to prevent.

runtime_proof_pending.ci_evidence_that_the_run_is_green: `Writable DB proof (staging only)` passes on PR head ff4ff627c5284eea19782a763e126a64791b336b.

defect_1.statement: Command Center auth handling conflicted with the canonical behaviour: token-only was refused.
defect_1.closed_by: the deploy-time check now mirrors deploy/production/nextjs-entrypoint.sh and assertCommandCenterAuthConfig -- a token OR a complete username/password pair; a partial pair and no auth at all are both refused before anything is written
defect_1.behavioural_evidence: the real auth fragment is extracted from BOTH env-write steps and executed against six configurations in a clean environment; token-only, a complete pair, and both together are accepted, and the three incomplete shapes fail closed with ::error::

defect_2.statement: Rollback could select the Command Center profile for a target release without the configuration needed to run it.
defect_2.closed_by: the profile is now decided on the remote host from the target release's own restored snapshot; --command-center is intent, and a requested-but-unrunnable profile is refused with an operator warning rather than selected
defect_2.behavioural_evidence: deploy/rollback.sh --dry-run's real remote command is executed against a docker stub that refuses the command-center profile when .env.command-center is absent, across flag x snapshot combinations

defect_3.statement: The Caddy-removal recovery condition was too broad: a generic Docker conflict removed the public edge.
defect_3.closed_by: removal now requires evidence the edge itself is blocking -- a port conflict naming 80 or 443, or a container-name conflict naming the caddy container; every other failure restores the edge and exits 1, and the bounded one-retry recovery for a genuine edge conflict is preserved
defect_3.behavioural_evidence: the real PROMOTE_REMOTE heredoc is executed against docker stubs in four conflict modes: a foreign container-name conflict and a conflict on a port the edge does not own both leave the edge served; a genuine 80/443 conflict and a stale caddy container are both recovered in one retry; a failed retry still restores the edge

pm_changes_required_round.unchanged: containment, the internal-only Command Center posture, the production-transaction protections introduced by this PR, and the release/inflight marker ordering are all unchanged by this round.
